rust_summary: A gated server-side placement rule for the player inventory's crafting inputs.
doc_summary: Set inventory_slot_rules_listened to receive inventory_slot_rules(player, slot, stack). Return Flow::Cancel to refuse that stack in player-inventory crafting input slot 1..=4. Normal menu clicks, swaps, drag, quick moves and recipe placement check the rule; LAN guest click prediction uses the existing correction. Creative slot packets are checked separately, but source preservation across separate packets needs confirmation. A refused crafting remainder goes to the player's inventory, or is dropped if it does not fit. Other menus and slots are unchanged. Requires native hooks API @API:inventory_slot_rules@.
